title: Tansun Surges on News of Deal to Purchase 20,000 Nvidia GPUs
key_facts: Tansun Technology announced on 9 Oct 2026 a deal to buy 20,000 new Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell chips.
Its shares closed up 12.38% at CNY16.16 (about USD2.4); no further details were revealed.
A staff member told Yicai the company still needed to confirm whether disclosure requirements had been met.
The RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell is a workstation product, not typically seen as suited to large-scale AI training in data centres; Nvidia's site says 'coming soon'.
Its memory bandwidth is 1,395GB/s versus about 3TB/s for the H100.
Yicai estimates the price at CNY80,000 to 120,000 per chip, so the order at CNY1.6 billion to 2.4 billion.
Tansun serves banks with AI and blockchain consulting and fintech products, and had a net loss of CNY138 million last year.
quote_evidence: (Yicai) Oct. 9 -- Chinese fintech service provider Tansun Technology has announced a deal involving procurement of 20,000 new RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell chips from US chip giant Nvidia.
Tansun [SHE: 300872] closed up 12.38 percent at CNY16.16 (USD2.4) today, following the announcement, even though no further details about the deal were revealed.
Yicai called the firm, posing as an investor, and a member of staff said they still need to confirm whether the disclosure requirements have been met.
why_it_matters_hint: A small Chinese firm says it will buy 20,000 Nvidia workstation chips; details are thin.
